% A guard: cases the fix must not break. Packages that pass pdfTeX's
% driver option on, loaded before the package they pass it to is loaded
% again with the option: rotating and epsfig before graphicx, and colortbl
% before color. None is a clash, as in pdflatex. xcolor, loaded last,
% gives the rows the colors of tex4ht's xcolor configuration.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[pdftex]{rotating}
\usepackage[pdftex]{epsfig}
\usepackage[pdftex]{graphicx}
\usepackage[pdftex]{colortbl}
\usepackage[pdftex]{color}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\begin{document}
Rotated: \rotatebox{90}{up}. After the rotation.

Epsfig: \epsfig{file=test-picture.png, width=1cm}. After epsfig.

Text in \textcolor{red}{red}.

\begin{tabular}{ll}
\rowcolor{yellow} one & two \\
three & four \\
\end{tabular}
\end{document}
